CDNG Image local modifications, 2026-10-24

Based on ljpeg 0.1.2. Original license and copyright notices are retained.
Changes introduced in CDNG Image 0.1.2:
src/encoder.rs: use a 64-bit accumulator for JPEG bit output; combine each
Huffman code with its amplitude before writing. Encoded bytes are required to
match the upstream implementation, including 0xff stuffing and final padding.
Additional local regression tests compare output to a scalar reference.

This modified source is used through the application's Cargo path dependency
and included in the distributed application source archive.

CDNG Image 0.1.3 changes:
Use integer histogram counts, with frequency one for the reserved pseudo-symbol,
when building length-limited canonical Huffman tables (T.81 Annex K). The upstream
normalization gave that symbol a weight equal to a full component. Resulting
encoded bytes can change; all RAW values must remain exactly equal.
Use count-leading-zero category selection and specialize two-component loops
to avoid a runtime integer remainder for every sample.
Tests exercise prefix-free code tables, the 16-bit length bound, reserved all-ones
codes, and decoding with the unmodified upstream decoder across 420 settings.

The 0.1.3 bit writer flushes complete 64-bit words, using bulk byte writes
when no JPEG byte stuffing is needed. Scalar reference tests cover word
boundaries, 0xff stuffing and final padding.

CDNG Image 0.1.4 changes:
Add Encoder::plan_entropy to build JPEG prefixes and packed canonical codes
from externally counted DC categories, allowing the Metal entropy writer to
produce byte-identical JPEG streams. The CPU encoder remains available.
Specialize the two-component lossless JPEG decoder loop without changing its
predictors or full RAW verification. Other component counts keep the generic
path. Both directions are checked against the upstream decoder/encoder.
